fields.description: Ocean Star brings one- to three-bedroom apartments to Rashid Yachts & Marina. Its two buildings sit around landscaped shared spaces, with balconies and larger first-floor terraces offering different ways to use the waterfront setting. The collection is apartment-only; it should not be confused with nearby Ocean Point’s townhouse offering.
amenities: Indoor and outdoor children’s play areas

reviewCoverage.identity: Ocean Star distinguished from Ocean Point; launch unit mix attributed, conflicting investor-table reproduction disclosed.
reviewCoverage.location: Rashid Yachts & Marina / Mina Rashid checked and mapped.
reviewCoverage.residences: One-, two- and three-bedroom apartments in two buildings; no townhouse category in the documents.
reviewCoverage.areas: Both building-specific plan sets extracted, with range endpoints and representative layouts visually checked.
reviewCoverage.amenities: Developer-listed residential facilities separated from master-community and proposed school/clinic references.
reviewCoverage.pricing: AED 1.7m developer headline and launch bedroom-specific starts recorded without availability claims.
reviewCoverage.payment: Ten 10% stages visually checked in the branded launch schedule; portal agrees with 10/80/10.
reviewCoverage.handover: July 2028 in launch documents conflicts with Property Finder’s March 2028; both attributed.
reviewCoverage.documents: Official brochure and Building 2 plans; broker-hosted Building 1, fact and payment PDFs inspected.

overview: The brochure places Ocean Star beside the marina district’s landscaped paths, canal-pool setting and promenade. Apartment layouts combine open kitchen and living areas with separate bedrooms and outdoor space. Brochure references to nearby schooling and a clinic describe the planned setting; they do not establish that those services are operating or included in ownership.
research.locationNote: Ocean Star is in Rashid Yachts & Marina, Mina Rashid, Dubai. Emaar identifies the QE2 Hotel and routes towards Downtown Dubai and Dubai International Airport. Check a specific unit’s orientation and the surrounding development schedule before relying on a particular view or amenity.
research.priceNote: Emaar advertises AED 1.7m. The launch fact sheet starts one-bedroom apartments at AED 1.7m, two-bedroom at AED 2.4m and three-bedroom at AED 3.4m. These are launch benchmarks; current inventory and a unit-specific quotation need confirmation.
research.paymentNote: The launch document sets ten payments of 10%: booking, eight intermediate stages and the completion balance. Property Finder corroborates 10/80/10. Historical dates are shown for context; the schedule for a new purchase must come from its contract.
research.handoverNote: The branded launch payment sheet estimates July 2028, while Property Finder reports March 2028. Q3 2028 here follows the launch document, not a confirmed completion announcement. Obtain the latest building-specific contractual date.

facts.label: Launch unit mix
facts.value: The launch sheet lists 58 one-bedroom, 76 two-bedroom and 20 three-bedroom apartments: 154 homes. This is a launch-document count, not remaining stock.

facts.label: Different published counts
facts.value: An online reproduction of Emaar’s FY2025 investor table assigns 217 units to Ocean Star, conflicting with the 154-home launch sheet. The current total needs direct confirmation.

facts.label: First-floor outdoor space
facts.value: Building 1 unit 113 has 1,456.36 sq ft suite plus 568.66 sq ft terrace, totalling 2,025.01 sq ft. Its three-bedroom plan also labels utility, laundry and storage spaces.

facts.label: A compact home with a larger terrace
facts.value: Building 2 unit 112 combines 731.41 sq ft suite and 262.1 sq ft terrace. Its 993.51 sq ft total includes outdoor space; it is not indoor-only area.

unresolved: Confirm the current completion date: the launch payment document and Property Finder differ.

The investor-table reproduction and launch sheet disagree on unit count. The old official investor-PDF URL now redirects to Emaar’s homepage; the reproduced table was read as text, not visually checked against the original slide.
Current availability, construction status, service charges, parking entitlements and final specifications require confirmation.
Images remain illustrative; project photography is deferred.
